subject: Private Offer: Brightline renewal — capacity acceleration & attestation
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <procurement@brightline.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <carlos@brightline.ai>
Date: 2026-10-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private offer & capacity acceleration request — renewal

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick answers earlier. Brightline's renewal is coming up and the leadership team wants to move from our current PAYG listing on the AWS Marketplace into a private offer with a committed capacity uplift. Goal: lock in a 12-month term but accelerate 2x capacity in Q1 to handle a pilot expansion.

We have two asks up front:
- Confirmation that private offer paperwork can reflect a 12-month term with an optional expansion window (up to +50% capacity) within the first 90 days.
- SOC2 attestation and an evidence index for our procurement / security review (we need specific docs and dates).

I attached a short outline of their procurement timeline. Can you propose a mutual action plan and point people on your side who will own legal/finance signoffs?

Thanks,
Alicia
Brightline Labs
procurement@brightline.ai
Attachment: Brightline_Timeline.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <procurement@brightline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer & capacity acceleration request — renewal

Alicia — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline.

We can absolutely support a 12-month private offer with an early expansion window. High-level proposal:
- Private Offer: 12 months, base committed vCPU/GPU units X with an expansion clause allowing up to +50% capacity within first 90 days. Expansion triggered by a signed amendment and invoice realignment.
- Billing: we propose two tranches (initial commit + accelerated top-up) to match your fiscal cadence — invoice #1 at acceptance, invoice #2 on expansion.
- Evidence: attaching a summarized PO term sheet. Priyom will lead legal redlines; Ben will own the billing/tranche mapping.

Next steps (mutual action plan):
1) We put draft private offer + term sheet in DocuSign for signature (we'll include the expansion amendment clause).
2) Brightline confirms evidence items required (SOC2 report, retention policy, privacy addendum).
3) Finance/Procurement exchange PO details and billing contacts.

I attached the PO_Term_Summary.pdf — Ben, Priyom, can you confirm the proposed tranche approach and whether we need to include any marketplace-specific language for AWS private offers (PO vs MP order flow)?

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment: PO_Term_Summary.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <procurement@brightline.ai>
Date: 2026-10-08T08:19:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer & capacity acceleration request — renewal

Adding a few tactical details on billing and the evidence ask so Alicia has what she needs for procurement:

Billing notes:
- Tranche A (acceptance) = 60% of committed spend invoiced on acceptance.
- Tranche B (post-expansion) = 40% invoiced when Brightline exercises the expansion clause; we can prorate monthly if they hit expansion mid-cycle.
- Marketplace flow: we will create the private offer in AWS Marketplace (metered to the private offer) and mirror the invoice in our systems — finance will provide a consolidated invoice.

Evidence & security docs we can provide immediately:
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest period) — available after NDA/secure link.
- Data retention and deletion policy (doc).
- KMS key handling summary and EU/US residency notes (if you need on-prem or govcloud specifics, flag it).

Attachment: evidence-index.csv (CSV stub listing doc names and pointers).

Priyom — anything legal wants to include re: acceptance window or hard caps? I recommended the expansion language be "customer-initiated amendment" with 7 business days for Redwood to provision additional capacity and an explicit billing ratchet.

Ben
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <procurement@brightline.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <carlos@brightline.ai>
Date: 2026-10-08T12:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer & capacity acceleration request — renewal

Thanks Ben — that tranche split works for our CFO. A couple clarifications:
- We need the SOC2 Type II report and the evidence-index by COB next Tuesday to satisfy our audit window. Can you send the secure link?
- For the expansion, procurement wants a guaranteed 7-business-day provisioning SLA in writing and a fallback to a lower-latency region if primary capacity can't be provisioned on time.
- For billing, can you add an optional clause to prorate the Tranche B invoice over the remainder of the year if expansion happens >60 days after acceptance?

We'll also need the private-offer paperwork for our signatory (Carlos Rivera, Head of Ops). If you can route a DocuSign with the term sheet + expansion amendment, we can complete signature week of Oct 19.

Link: https://brightline.ai/secure/procurement-note (for internal tracking)

Best,
Alicia
Attachment: procurement_checklist.xlsx (xlsx stub)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Brightline private offer — legal/finance checklist and owners

Team — quick internal checklist to get ahead of DocuSign and the marketplace flow. Pulling together the docs Alicia requested and confirming owners: 

1) Draft private offer (marketplace language + expansion amendment) — Owner: Priyom (legal) — deliverable: draft DocuSign by 2026-10-13. Attachment: draft-private-offer.docx
2) Evidence bundle & secure link (SOC2, retention policy, KMS summary) — Owner: Ben (sales) / Security ops — deliverable: secure S3 link + access list by 2026-10-13.
3) Billing cadence & tranche invoice templates — Owner: Marissa (finance) — deliverable: sample invoice + prorate clause language by 2026-10-12.
4) Provisioning SLA text to include 7 business day window + fallback region options — Owner: Kimberly / Infra ops — deliverable: SLA text snippet for contract by 2026-10-12.

I'll prepare the initial DocuSign package after we have the SLA snippet and finance confirms tranche language. Ben/Marissa, please sync offline and put the final invoice terms in the draft. Alicia, if Brightline can confirm the signatory details for Carlos (name as it should appear, billing address for PO) that will speed acceptance.

Thanks — Priyom
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
